title: More proactive Asean response to disasters, better warning systems pushed
summary: MANILA, Philippines – President Ferdinand R.Marcos Jr. on Tuesday called for a more proactive response to disasters and calamities from members of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – President Ferdinand R.Marcos Jr. on Tuesday called for a more proactive response to disasters and calamities from members of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) and enhance early warning systems as the region faces extreme natural events due to climate change. Marcos said Asean must improve its ability to anticipate hazards,
